title: GPIO pulse finalizers report OFF after a failed hardware stop
summary: Pulse finalizers ignore the failed OFF write, clear the deadline and publish OFF even when the relay may remain energized. Source-confirmed independent driver review; no hardware reproduction. Next: propagate stop failure and test failed OFF writes with a fake backend.

resolution.evidence: 20261025074335-0b62-fix-rpio-gpio-findings/verification.md; relay_pulse_finalizer() keeps a port ON and publishes AUX_GPIO_OUTLETS ALERT on a failed OFF write in aux_rpio 12 and aux_asiair 8; 'failed pulse end is reported' in both suites.
